scope: Main Codex project session through the first public GitHub release; excludes later README attribution work and separate agent sessions.
method: Summed the final cumulative token counters in four monotonic counter segments, ignoring duplicate snapshots. Cross-checked against summed last-call usage for all distinct snapshots. Cached input is part of input, and reasoning output is part of output; neither is added twice. These counts include repeated context and are not unique words, generated code size, a bill, or a benchmark.
